config.expected_if_false: Final force margin <= 0.18 in both seeds and a step-6000-to-12000 gain <= 0.02 in both seeds, meaning force levels off below the N=64 band (lower ceiling). Any other pattern is reported as inconclusive.
config.expected_if_true: Final (step 12000) force margin >= 0.20 in both seeds, with a step-6000-to-12000 gain >= 0.03 in both. accel_step headroom-normalised margin in [0.62, 0.77] in both seeds.
config.hypothesis: At N=128 the lower force margin is a slower growth rate, not a lower ceiling. With seeds 20-21, architecture and data matched to exp-20261013-021753-b8bd (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1], best-of-3 controls), training to 12000 steps lets the best-layer force margin keep rising from 0.178 and 0.163 at step 6000 until it reaches the N=64 band (>= 0.20). The headroom-normalised accel_step margin stays flat. Margins are read from the per-checkpoint trajectory as unrounded values against a strict >= required_margin bar, with force taken at its best layer at each checkpoint. If either seed's step-6000 force margin differs by more than 0.03 from the 6000-step run of the same seed, within-run growth is the primary measure and cross-run comparisons are reported as horizon-confounded.
